== Description ==

[[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] (left, maroon tee with a white antler graphic, beard, light brown hair), [[Taylor Gosiaco]] (right, navy shirt, tortoiseshell glasses, name tag, curly-haired man in brown also at right-rear), and [[Jordan Gosiaco]] (back right, curly hair, brown shirt, glasses) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
